productTitle: Basketball-Inspired Mesh Lace-Up Casual Sneakers with Rear Pull Tab Model BQ-CS063C
companyDesc: Quanzhou Beiqiang Footwear & Apparel Co., Ltd. is based in Quanzhou, Fujian, China. The company images introduce our general footwear development and order coordination capabilities. Model-specific samples, customization, packing and dispatch arrangements are reviewed against your requirements before quotation.
textDesc: Basketball-inspired casual sneaker styling with a mesh textile upper, lace-up closure, rear pull tab and rubber outsole. The source specifies a rubber + MD sole assembly; separate midsole and lining compositions are not specified. Choose six color combinations shown in the actual photos and listed size labels 36–45; confirm size measurements before ordering. Minimum order: 2 pairs. Send your quantities by color and size, destination and packing requirements for a quotation. Performance, availability and customization are confirmed for your selected order; no tested sporting or medical performance is claimed.
companyFaqDesc: The upper is mesh textile and the outsole is rubber. The source specifies a rubber + MD sole assembly; separate midsole and lining compositions are not specified.
The shoe has a lace-up closure and a rear pull tab. The images show the actual construction.
Listed size labels are 36–45. The sizing system is not specified; please confirm measurements and your quantities by size before ordering.
The minimum order is 2 pairs. Please send the colors, sizes and quantities you need so we can confirm the order details.
How are price and delivery confirmed?
2–49 pairs: USD 13.43/pair; 50–99 pairs: USD 12.54/pair; 100+ pairs: USD 11.65/pair. Freight, packing and dispatch timing are confirmed for your order.
Can I request samples or a packaging change?
Please send your sample quantity and packaging requirements. Feasibility, price and timing will be confirmed for your request before an order is accepted.
